subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-inject SKILL.md content when skill is invoked via slash command

question: Should explicit non-tool skill slash commands automatically inject SKILL.md content into model context, and what instruction authority and isolation boundary should that content have?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but turning slash-invoked skills from advisory text into guaranteed context changes how potentially untrusted skill instructions affect the agent.

options.title: Define guarded core injection
options.body: Load the matching SKILL.md for explicit slash invocation, but mark it with clear untrusted-content delimiters, precedence rules, transcript behavior, and tests.

options.title: Prefer a Skill/tool route
options.body: Route deterministic activation through a dedicated Skill-style tool or plugin contract so skill content enters through a tool-mediated boundary.

options.title: Keep advisory routing
options.body: Document the current behavior as intentional and direct deterministic workflows to `command-dispatch: tool` or bundle command templates.

recommendation.title: Define guarded core injection
recommendation.body: Load the matching SKILL.md for explicit slash invocation, but mark it with clear untrusted-content delimiters, precedence rules, transcript behavior, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the current slash-command skill surface and recent prompt/command routing edits points to steipete.
